title: Cipher sheet from Mr Eichel, 1758, TNA SP 106/7 (DECODE R595)

documents.route: Mr Eichel (probably A. F. Eichel, Frederick II's cabinet secretary) -> unknown; held by the Deciphering Branch

plaintext.source: No decipherment exists; the sheet carries no message.

transcription.notes: 139 groups counted by script from the DECODE transcription; a looped glyph transcribed '8?' is probably 0.

system.summary: Numerical code of R596 (French, values 504-3293): every number containing a 7, 1-503, 1115-1198, 1483-1999 and 2600-2802 are nulls. The letter uses only nulls and cells left blank in the key.
system.notes: Key R594, named by DECODE, does not fit.

prior_solution.where: DECODE: Non-decrypted; note points to R594 (wrong key).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, posed the target with /goal from the catalogue. No target-specific intervention.

solution.what: Fetched R595 and R594 metadata, images and DECODE transcriptions with the stored cookie.
Read the dockets: 'Cypher from Mr Eichel 1758', 'Prussia 1758'; Prussia, not Russia.
Applied key R594, as DECODE's note suggests.
Scored the transcriptions of 21 SP 106 and Prussian key records for coverage of the letter's groups; R596's null rules (numbers with 7, set ranges) match the letter's pattern.
Applied R596's null rules: 117/139 groups are nulls; 21 of the 22 others fall on the key's blank cells (7% base rate, p ~ 1e-23).
Reread the looped glyph as 0 instead of 8: 27 survivors, 20 blank, the rest isolated words making no sentence.

outcome.method_basis: The sheet carries no message: under the null rules of key R596 (found here by scoring 21 SP 106 key records) 117 of 139 groups are nulls and 21 of the other 22 fall on blank cells of the key.
outcome.notes: Not a message: a dummy sheet written entirely in non-values of key R596 (nulls by rule and blank cells). R596 undated; its tie to Eichel not established.
